name: Web Research
description:
Non-software domain: pure source-grounded research over web substrate. Coordinator instantiates with a topic and source budget; researcher plans, queries web_search, synthesizes a source-grounded findings artifact (OSINT discipline — every claim cites a source, confidence is graded, corroboration is noted); reviewer-research grades the artifact against the plan's verifiable outcomes.

First non-software template — exercises the harness extensibility claim that adding a new prompt class is config-only. Phase 2a skeleton: body is a valid flow shape that passes Flow.Validate but does not yet wire the agentic components. Phase 2b expands the body to a runnable researcher-only topology (no architect/builder; no semsource), with web_search as the primary tool.
body:
{
  "id": "web-research-{{.topic_slug}}",
  "name": "Web Research: {{.topic}}",
  "description": "Source-grounded web research on {{.topic}} (max_sources={{.max_sources}}, confidence_threshold={{.confidence_threshold}}, model={{.model}}). OSINT discipline: every claim cites a source; confidence graded; corroboration noted.",
  "version": 0,
  "runtime_state": "not_deployed",
  "nodes": [],
  "connections": []
}

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Human-readable research question or topic. Shown in the flow name.

parameters.name: topic_slug
parameters.description: Kebab-case slug of the topic. Used in the flow ID. Coordinator derives from topic.

parameters.name: max_sources
parameters.description: Maximum number of distinct web sources the researcher should consult before synthesizing. Higher for broad surveys, lower for quick checks.

parameters.name: confidence_threshold
parameters.description: Minimum confidence level for a claim to land in the findings artifact unqualified. Below this threshold, the claim is marked as 'preliminary' or dropped. Values: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: LLM endpoint name from the model_registry. Web research benefits from models with strong reading comprehension; claude-haiku is the cost-effective default.
